summary:
This is a stale re-validation at 199f0e1. Two things changed since my pass at ff666b0:
- **The uat merge (a0b028b).** It brought in SL-072, which touched only CancelledFolderTests.cs, the new Scans.cs, SynchronousIoCancelTests.cs and TopLevelTests.cs, all in tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests, plus SL-072's .taad files.
- **Build attempt 7.** C-007 now replaces CRLF with LF in the harness output before its `Contains("'name'")` check. That is 3 lines added and 1 removed in RuleCases.ps1. Shape-ImportRuleNames also gained a `name: >` probe and a `name: |` probe.

These are absent from the ff666b0..199f0e1 diff: eng/, .taad/fitness.yaml, ArchitectureRulesTests.cs, SettledCountProbe.ps1, src/ and the acceptance repro.

**Everything I re-ran at HEAD passed.**
- **Parity:** AGREE 11/15/27/49 under powershell.exe and pwsh.
- **C-001 to C-005:** exit 0 under both hosts. The ok counts are 8, 34, 26, 26 and 230, the same as last time.
- **C-006, C-007 and C-009 with the engine:** exit 0 under both hosts. C-007 reports 'xunit 11 Facts, 0 hits' and names its 1 import rule.
- **Sibling test `-Shape All`:** exits 0 in 487 s with 187 ok and 0 FAIL.
- **`-Shape EngineCases`:** exits 0 in 318 s with 29 ok. C-007 and C-008 pass on this tree and on the 12/17/28 two-scope copy. C-008 expects 11/14/27/49 and 12/16/28/49.
- **`-Shape ImportRuleNames`:** exits 0. It names 11 import rules on both hosts.
- **SettledCountProbe:** Misclassified and GuardRule both exit 0. On the 14-twinned stub, C-001 still fails with 4 checks.
- **Fitness:** all 64 rules hold.
- **Rules harness:** 48/48 AS-RECORDED and 0 stray hits.
- **Default test suite on the merged tree:** 394/394 pass. SL-072 is a refactor and left the count unchanged.

**O-029 is fixed, and I checked it independently.** My own scratch copy of the repo had three import rules whose names carry newlines:
- the exact `name: >` rule that failed my last pass;
- a `|+` keep-chomped name ending in two newlines, which the builder did not feed;
- a folded name with an embedded newline from a paragraph break, which the builder also did not feed.

C-007 names all 4 on both hosts and exits 0. With the Replace removed from the copy's RuleCases.ps1, C-007 exits 1 with 'unnamed: …'. So the fix is what makes it pass.

**This slice has been going round in a loop.**
- Build attempts 3 to 7 were each sent back by code-review over the same C-007 comparison between yaml names and the harness's printed text (O-025, O-026/O-027, O-028, O-029).
- Attempts 5 to 7 changed only tests.
- Validate attempts 2 to 5 were all taken back as stale because uat moved or a build landed, never because the judgement was wrong.

None of this touches the slice's deliverable, the recounted parity figures, which has held since validate 1. The one change that would end the name-comparison loop has not been built: the harness would print the NOT RUN names as a JSON list, and C-007 would compare lists. A person needs to rank it; otherwise the next reviewer can name a sixth spelling axis.

**What I assumed.** The bug report is only a title. I took as acceptance:
- the engine's repro, whose exit 0 is on record as O-001 (the file is unchanged, so I did not re-run it);
- the slice's two statements;
- the C-003 lookahead that was cut as already built (still at line 332);
- the design's 14 cases.

The block is headed 'What this slice has to do, as the design fixed it', not 'What this slice owes', and it has 14 items, which is more than `planned` can hold. So `planned` is empty and the 14 cases are graded under `criteria`.

**Clean-up.** My runs created no fsa-* folders in %TEMP% (1394 before and after), and my scratch folder is removed. No testhost, dotnet or VBCSCompiler process started during this run is still alive. git status shows only the engine's .taad files.

criteria.how: At 199f0e1, -Shape All's GuardRule passes: it fires on the pinned pre-fix literals and on nothing in this tree. SettledCountProbe Misclassified still exits 0, so the counts are recounted and not read back from the tool. Fitness op=check holds all 64 rules.

criteria.how: In -Shape All, SingleScope (12/16/28) and TwoScope (12/17/28) held C-001, C-003, C-004 and C-005 on both hosts. EngineCases held C-007 and C-008 on the 12/17/28 copy. The engine repro's exit 0 is on record (O-001), and the file is unchanged.

criteria.how: Present at RuleCases.ps1:332. C-003 passes on the real tree under both hosts, and inside SingleScope, TwoScope and C003Settled.

criteria.how: SingleScope in -Shape All (exit 0, 0 FAIL): C-001 holds under powershell.exe and pwsh.

criteria.criterion: Design 2: C-001, C-003, C-004, C-005 on a two-scope rule (Facts +1, Twinned +2)
criteria.how: TwoScope in -Shape All holds all four cases under both hosts. EngineCases confirms the copy AGREEs at 12/17/28/49.

criteria.how: The ExpectFactsMismatch shape ran in -Shape All with 0 FAIL rows. RuleCases.ps1's C-005 is untouched by this diff.

criteria.how: C003Settled in -Shape All (exit 0, 0 FAIL) under both hosts.

criteria.how: SettledMarkers in -Shape All with 0 FAIL rows. The real tree's C-001 expects 49 settled and passes.

criteria.how: The NoMarker shape ran in -Shape All with 0 FAIL rows: C-001 stops by name before any parity run, and C-002 still runs.

criteria.how: UnreadableCs (three variants) ran in -Shape All with 0 FAIL rows.

criteria.how: SettledCountProbe -Shape Misclassified exits 0 at 199f0e1. C-001 fails with 4 checks on the 14-twinned stub on both hosts.

criteria.criterion: Design 10: C-001 with a Fact the parity reader cannot see
criteria.how: UnseenFact in -Shape All with 0 FAIL rows under both hosts.

criteria.criterion: Design 11: host parity powershell.exe 5.1 and pwsh 7
criteria.how: Every case above ran under both hosts with identical outcomes. The HostParity shape ran in -Shape All with 0 FAIL rows.

criteria.criterion: Design 12: literal-count guard rule fires on HEAD-before-fix and not on the fixed file
criteria.how: The GuardRule shape in -Shape All passes: it hits the pinned pre-fix literals and nothing in the current files. SettledCountProbe -Shape GuardRule also exits 0.

criteria.criterion: Design 13: Get-RuleCounts reading a yaml and .cs with a UTF-8 BOM
criteria.how: HostParity puts a BOM on both files, and it ran in -Shape All with 0 FAIL rows under both hosts.

criteria.criterion: Design 14: C-007 'xunit N Facts' when the test class holds a [Theory] with several data rows
criteria.how: Not re-run this pass, because the stale diff does not touch parity, ArchitectureRulesTests.cs or C-007's Facts count. Validate-4 re-ran it at ff666b0: parity was CANNOT-READ at [InlineData(1)], and C-001 and C-007 both exited 1. At 199f0e1, C-007 still prints 'xunit 11 Facts' on the real tree and 'xunit 12 Facts' on the two-scope copy.

obligations.evidence: Fixed at 199f0e1. On my own scratch copy, the exact `name: >` rule that failed at ff666b0 is named by C-007 on both hosts, and so are a `|+` name ending in two newlines and a folded name with an embedded newline, which the builder did not feed. C-007 exits 0 with 'the 4 import rule(s) are named NOT RUN … (unnamed: )'. With the Replace removed from the copy, C-007 exits 1 with 'unnamed: the provider's folded-with-newline probe…'. The builder's ImportRuleNames shape also exits 0 with 11 names.
The engine's exit 0 is on record. The repro file is not in the ff666b0..199f0e1 diff. At HEAD the recount it depends on still holds: SingleScope is green at 12/16/28 on both hosts.
SettledCountProbe -Shape Misclassified exits 0 at 199f0e1, and C-001 fails with 4 checks on the 14-twinned stub on both hosts.

not_reached: A real future slice that declares a twinned rule through the engine's own flow. Only scratch copies (SingleScope, TwoScope, EngineCases) were run, so it stays unknown until one lands whether the next twinned slice will leave RuleCases.ps1 untouched.
A real import rule whose name is non-ASCII, wrapped, commented, folded or broken across lines. None exists in the yaml, so the O-028 and O-029 fixes were measured only on scratch copies.

Name spellings C-007 still compares as text and that no stage has probed, such as a name holding "', '" or a quote beside the list separator. Nothing structural closes that class until the harness prints a machine-readable list.
The acceptance repro was not re-run, by design. Its exit 0 is the engine's measurement (O-001).

SL-072's changes (the shared Scans.cs helper and the refactored cancel tests) were exercised only through the 394-test Core.Tests run, the rules harness and Fitness. I did not read them line by line; that belongs to SL-072's own validate.
